events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival began in 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Summer of Love legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, hundreds of thousands gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. What's your favourite memory or track from that legendary festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Remembering the King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley. His music and style continue to influence generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's legacy
angles.copy: Today marks the passing of an undeniable force in music, Tupac Shakur. His lyrical genius and impact on hip-hop remain as powerful as ever.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar legend tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix. His innovative guitar work redefined rock music forever. Which Hendrix track is your all-time favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road at 57
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. From the iconic zebra crossing to timeless tracks, what makes this album special for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's big day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude have made The Pretenders rock legends.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's "Imagine" UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic "Imagine" single was released in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine at 51
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: iPod's 25th anniversary
events.blurb: Apple launched its revolutionary first iPod in 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: The original iPod
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod dropped? It completely revolutionised how we carry and listen to our music. How many songs did your first one hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's cinematic legacy.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Time to celebrate the world's most famous secret agent. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire peace and love around the globe.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's comedic genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, known as "The White Album," in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album at 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that showed their incredible range. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting continue to make him one of music's greatest icons.
